verdicts_or_reports.element: Undo action in the deletion snackbar
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Tapping Undo should restore the deleted note and its two cards, returning the Spanish browser to 6 cards shown.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After tapping the snackbar Undo button, the snackbar disappears but the Spanish browser remains at 4 cards shown and the deleted note stays absent. The separate More options > Undo Delete Note command restores it.
steps: Create and save a Basic (and reversed card) note in Spanish with Front QA_FRONT_42 and Back QA_BACK_99.
Open Card browser filtered to Spanish.
Long-press the note's Card 1 row, open More options, and choose Delete note.
When the snackbar displays 2 cards deleted and Undo, tap Undo.
Observe that the browser still shows 4 cards and the QA_FRONT_42 note is absent.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Undo button in the delete snackbar
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Undo should restore the deleted QA_FRONT_42 note and its two cards; the browser should return to 6 cards shown.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The snackbar disappears after its Undo button is tapped, but the list stays at 4 cards shown and QA_FRONT_42 remains absent. I reproduced this with both the accessibility element tap and a direct tap at the visible Undo button; More options > Undo Delete Note restores the note.
steps: In the Spanish deck, save a Basic (and reversed card) note with Front QA_FRONT_42 and Back QA_BACK_99.
Open Card browser filtered to Spanish and verify 6 cards shown.
Long-press QA_FRONT_42 Card 1, open More options, and tap Delete note.
While the snackbar reads 2 cards deleted and shows Undo at the lower right, tap Undo.
The snackbar disappears; the browser still reads 4 cards shown and has no QA_FRONT_42 rows.
Open More options > Undo Delete Note; this restores the note and returns the browser to 6 cards shown.
